panels.title: Event Loop Lag (p99 trend, max gate)
panels.description: Sampler-interval event-loop delay from server.resources. p99 (event_loop_p99_ms) is an ungated trend. max (event_loop_max_ms) is the stall spike and the release gate (TM99 100ms).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.event_loop_p99_ms') AS p99, json_extract(fields_json, '$.event_loop_max_ms') AS max FROM events WHERE name = 'server.resources' AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.event_loop_p99_ms') IS NOT NULL AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.cpu_user_pct') AS cpu_user, json_extract(fields_json, '$.cpu_system_pct') AS cpu_system, json_extract(fields_json, '$.cpu_total_pct') AS cpu_total FROM events WHERE name = 'server.resources' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.heap_used_mb') AS mem_heap_used, json_extract(fields_json, '$.heap_total_mb') AS mem_heap_total, json_extract(fields_json, '$.rss_mb') AS mem_rss, json_extract(fields_json, '$.external_mb') AS mem_external FROM events WHERE name = 'server.resources' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Active Sessions

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.sessions_busy') AS sessions_busy, json_extract(fields_json, '$.sessions_ready') AS sessions_ready, json_extract(fields_json, '$.sessions_starting') AS sessions_starting FROM events WHERE name = 'server.resources' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.description: Stacked busy, ready, and starting counts from server.resources. Their sum is sessions_total.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.ws_connections') AS ws_connections FROM events WHERE name = 'server.resources' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WebSocket Ping RTT (ms)
panels.description: Server-side ping/pong round-trip time. Key baseline for relay latency comparison.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.rtt_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.ws_ping' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WebSocket Handshake (ms)
panels.description: Server-side WebSocket upgrade duration (server.ws_handshake) and time to the first client message (server.ws_first_message). Compare with iOS app.ws_wait for user-visible connection readiness.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN name = 'server.ws_handshake' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END AS handshake, CASE WHEN name = 'server.ws_first_message' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END AS first_msg FROM events WHERE name IN ('server.ws_handshake', 'server.ws_first_message') AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WebSocket Session Stats
panels.description: One row per closed connection (server.ws_session): stream, duration, messages sent and received, and close code.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') AS stream, ROUND(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') / 1000.0, 1) AS duration_s, json_extract(fields_json, '$.messages_sent') AS sent, json_extract(fields_json, '$.messages_received') AS received, json_extract(tags_json, '$.close_code') AS close_code FROM events WHERE name = 'server.ws_session' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Agent Active Work Duration (not UX latency)
panels.description: Full agent turn wall-clock time (server.turn duration_ms). Long values usually mean active work; call it a UX problem only when correlated with high TTFT, no progress, tool hangs, errors, or disconnected clients.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.turn' AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') IS NOT NULL AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Server TTFT / first output wait (ms)
panels.description: Server-side wait from agent_start to first text_delta (server.turn_ttft). This is responsiveness; keep it separate from full active work duration.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.turn_ttft' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Turn Cost (µ$, summed)
panels.description: SUM(cost_usd_micros) of sum-aggregated server.turn_usage per interval, in microdollars, not a per-turn average.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time, SUM(json_extract(fields_json, '$.cost_usd_micros')) AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.turn_usage' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ask Round-Trip (ms)
panels.description: Ask extension round-trip latency (server.ask_round_trip): the full cycle from ask dispatch to user response received. Cancelled asks are included.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.ask_round_trip' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Session Title Gen (ms)
panels.description: Auto-title generation latency (server.session_title). Runs after the first user message to generate the session title.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.session_title' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Turn Tokens
panels.description: SUM(input_tokens) and SUM(output_tokens) of sum-aggregated server.turn_usage per interval. Not one point per turn.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time, SUM(json_extract(fields_json, '$.input_tokens')) AS input, SUM(json_extract(fields_json, '$.output_tokens')) AS output FROM events WHERE name = 'server.turn_usage' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Turn Tool Calls + Errors
panels.description: Tool calls per agent turn and failed turns (server.turn status=error). High tool counts can explain long active work duration; errors are reliability signals.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.tool_calls') AS tool_calls, CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN 1 END AS errors FROM events WHERE name = 'server.turn' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Session Subscribe (ms)
panels.description: Full subscribe flow duration including catch-up replay.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.session_subscribe' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: WS Ping Timeouts
panels.description: Dead connection detection events. Each point is a timed-out WebSocket.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, 1 AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.ws_ping_timeout' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Catch-up Replay
panels.description: Events replayed during catch-up (server.catchup result=replayed) and ring misses requiring a full reload (result=miss).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.result') = 'replayed' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.events') END AS events, CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.result') = 'miss' THEN 1 END AS misses FROM events WHERE name = 'server.catchup' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Broadcast Fanout
panels.description: MAX(subscribers) of max-aggregated server.broadcast_fanout: the peak subscriber count in each flush window, kept as the peak in each Grafana interval.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time, MAX(json_extract(fields_json, '$.subscribers')) AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.broadcast_fanout' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: HTTP Request Latency (ms)
panels.description: Raw server.http_request duration_ms, not aggregated. Fast successful routine routes are omitted, so this is not request volume. Use HTTP by route for p50/p90/p99 and error rate.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.http_request' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Auto Retries
panels.description: Automatic retry events (server.auto_retry); the value is the attempt number.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.attempt') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.auto_retry' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: HTTP by route
panels.description: Raw server.http_request duration_ms grouped by method and path_pattern. p50/p90/p99 use nearest-rank ceil(p * n). samples is row count. error_pct is status_code >= 400. Fast successful routine routes are omitted, so this is not request volume.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?') AS method,
    COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?') AS path_pattern,
    json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value,
    CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.status_code'), '0') AS INTEGER) AS status_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?'), COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?')
      ORDER BY json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')
    ) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?'), COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?')
    ) AS n
  FROM events
  WHERE name = 'server.http_request'
    AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
)
SELECT
  method,
  path_pattern,
  n AS samples,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 50 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p50_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 90 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p90_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 99 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 1) AS p99_ms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / n, 1) AS error_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY method, path_pattern, n
ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: HTTP response bytes by route
panels.description: Raw server.http_request response_bytes grouped by method and path_pattern; same event and gating as the latency panels, and unregistered routes record path_pattern=unregistered. p50/p90 use nearest-rank ceil(p * n). max_bytes is MAX(response_bytes). samples is row count, not request volume.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?') AS method,
    COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?') AS path_pattern,
    json_extract(fields_json, '$.response_bytes') AS value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?'), COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?')
      ORDER BY json_extract(fields_json, '$.response_bytes')
    ) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.method'), '?'), COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.path_pattern'), '?')
    ) AS n
  FROM events
  WHERE name = 'server.http_request'
    AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.response_bytes') IS NOT NULL
    AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
)
SELECT
  method,
  path_pattern,
  n AS samples,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 50 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 0) AS p50_bytes,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = ((n * 90 + 99) / 100) THEN value END), 0) AS p90_bytes,
  ROUND(MAX(value), 0) AS max_bytes
FROM ranked
GROUP BY method, path_pattern, n
ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: Compaction Duration (ms)
panels.description: Time spent compacting session event history (server.compaction duration_ms).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'server.compaction' AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') IS NOT NULL AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Compaction results
panels.description: server.compaction by status and result (will_retry): count and average duration.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.status'), '?') AS status, COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.result'), '(none)') AS result, COUNT(*) AS compactions, ROUND(AVG(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 0) AS avg_ms FROM events WHERE name = 'server.compaction' AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to} GROUP BY status, result ORDER BY compactions DESC

panels.title: WS handshake by stream
panels.description: Server-side WebSocket upgrade duration (server.ws_handshake) averaged per interval, split by stream: session, dictation, app_events.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') = 'session' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END), 1) AS session,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') = 'dictation' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END), 1) AS dictation,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') = 'app_events' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END), 1) AS app_events
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.ws_handshake'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: WS messages by stream
panels.description: Per-interval sent and received WebSocket messages (SUM of sum-aggregated server.ws_message_sent and server.ws_message_received) by stream.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') = 'session' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.messages') ELSE 0 END) AS session,
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') = 'dictation' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.messages') ELSE 0 END) AS dictation,
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') = 'app_events' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.messages') ELSE 0 END) AS app_events
FROM events
WHERE name IN ('server.ws_message_sent', 'server.ws_message_received')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session subscribe by status
panels.description: server.session_subscribe by status (ok or error): count and duration.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.status'), 'unknown') AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  ROUND(AVG(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 1) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(MIN(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 1) AS min_ms,
  ROUND(MAX(json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms')), 1) AS max_ms
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.session_subscribe'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY samples DESC, status

panels.title: WS close codes by stream
panels.description: Close-code counts by stream (one server.ws_session per connection). Watch for abnormal 1006 on the session and dictation streams.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream'), 'unknown') AS stream,
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.close_code'), 'unknown') AS close_code,
  COUNT(*) AS closes,
  datetime(MAX(ts_ms) / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS last_seen
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.ws_session'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY stream, close_code
ORDER BY closes DESC, stream, close_code

panels.title: Audio Stream Inbound
panels.description: Dictation stream inbound binary KiB (sum of binary_bytes) and control-message counts (server.ws_message_received, stream=dictation).

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(json_extract(fields_json, '$.binary_bytes'), 0)) / 1024.0, 1) AS audio_kib,
  SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.message_type') != 'binary_audio' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.messages') ELSE 0 END) AS control_messages
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.ws_message_received'
  AND json_extract(tags_json, '$.stream') = 'dictation'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Session create (total / SDK / bind)
panels.description: Raw session-create latencies. create_ms is server.session_create (the full SdkBackend.create duration); sdk_ms and bind_ms are the parts recorded in server.sdk_session_setup.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time,
  CASE WHEN name = 'server.session_create' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END AS create_ms,
  CASE WHEN name = 'server.sdk_session_setup' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.sdk_ms') END AS sdk_ms,
  CASE WHEN name = 'server.sdk_session_setup' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.bind_ms') END AS bind_ms
FROM events
WHERE name IN ('server.session_create', 'server.sdk_session_setup')
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Session end by reason
panels.description: server.session_end counted by reason.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.reason'), '?') AS reason,
  COUNT(*) AS ends
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.session_end'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY reason
ORDER BY ends DESC

panels.title: Push send latency (ms)
panels.description: server.push send_ms: encrypted seal-and-relay latency. Absent when the push never reached the relay.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.send_ms') AS push_send_ms
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.push'
  AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.send_ms') IS NOT NULL
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Push results
panels.description: server.push counted by notification (blocked, error, notify, pairing, Live Activity start/update/end) and relay result (delivered, gone, rejected, unavailable, failed, throttled, no_activity).

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.notification'), '?') AS notification,
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.result'), '?') AS result,
  COUNT(*) AS results
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.push'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY notification, result
ORDER BY results DESC

panels.title: Event ring utilization peak
panels.description: MAX(event_ring_peak_ratio) of server.resources: the fullest session event ring in each sample interval. Absent when no session holds a ring.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ((ts_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms}) / 1000 AS time,
  MAX(json_extract(fields_json, '$.event_ring_peak_ratio')) AS peak_ratio
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.resources'
  AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.event_ring_peak_ratio') IS NOT NULL
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Server STT and finalize (ms)
panels.description: server.dictation_finalize stt_ms and finalize_ms. Front-page STT latency also appears on Release Preflight.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time,
  json_extract(fields_json, '$.stt_ms') AS stt_ms,
  json_extract(fields_json, '$.finalize_ms') AS finalize_ms
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.dictation_finalize'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Server STT real-time factor
panels.description: server.dictation_finalize stt_audio_ratio. Below 1.0 is faster than real time.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time, json_extract(fields_json, '$.stt_audio_ratio') AS stt_audio_ratio
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.dictation_finalize'
  AND json_extract(fields_json, '$.stt_audio_ratio') IS NOT NULL
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Server dictation summary
panels.description: Every numeric field of the server dictation events, one row per event.field. avg/min/max read the field directly; the error rows count events, so their avg is not a latency.

panels.title: MCP connect latency (ms)
panels.description: server.mcp_connect duration over time, split by status. Config errors record 0. An ok sample is not a failure.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time,
  CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'ok' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END AS ok_ms,
  CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END AS error_ms
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.mcp_connect'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: MCP connect by status and error kind
panels.description: Count of server.mcp_connect events by status and error_kind (auth, connect, config). (none) means no error_kind, as on ok events.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.status'), '?') AS status,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.error_kind')), ''), '(none)') AS error_kind,
  COUNT(*) AS samples
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.mcp_connect'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY status, error_kind
ORDER BY samples DESC

panels.title: Schedule run duration (ms)
panels.description: server.schedule_run duration, split by status. Not the HTTP request that started a manual run.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT ts_ms / 1000 AS time,
  CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'ok' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END AS ok_ms,
  CASE WHEN json_extract(tags_json, '$.status') = 'error' THEN json_extract(fields_json, '$.duration_ms') END AS error_ms
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.schedule_run'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
ORDER BY ts_ms

panels.title: Schedule runs by status, kind, and reason
panels.description: Count of server.schedule_run events by status, run_kind (due or manual), and reason. An ok run is not a failure. (none) means no reason.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.status'), '?') AS status,
  COALESCE(json_extract(tags_json, '$.run_kind'), '?') AS run_kind,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(json_extract(tags_json, '$.reason')), ''), '(none)') AS reason,
  COUNT(*) AS samples
FROM events
WHERE name = 'server.schedule_run'
  AND ts_ms >= ${__from} AND ts_ms <= ${__to}
GROUP BY status, run_kind, reason
ORDER BY samples DESC

title: Oppi Server Health
description: Server resource health, connection and agent workload, plus collapsed drill-down for session lifecycle, push, event ring, MCP connect, schedule runs, and dictation. Everything reads the telemetry catalog's `events` table (server.* events; fields in fields_json, tags in tags_json). Event-loop p99 is the ungated trend; max is the stall gate. Events with catalog storage aggregation (server.turn_usage, server.ws_message_*, server.broadcast_fanout) hold a flush-window sum or peak per record: SUM or MAX them, and do not count rows. HTTP timings and response bytes are raw events.
